parsed.post: Discarding the 1.055 run. It seems my attempt to test a lower LR (0.01) on the previous config actually performed worse than the clean baseline. It's clear that the '0-10' results were invalid due to leakage. Reverting to the clean depth-6 baseline. Next: testing MATRIX_LR=0.04 on clean '0-9' shards.
parsed.description: Reverting to clean '0-9' shards and testing MATRIX_LR=0.04 to see if it follows the trend of lower LR improving performance on depth-6 architectures.
